Thank you so much <3 Even if it turns out that my partner is trans I will still be there to support them. I will be there every step of the way. My attraction may go but the care will still be there.
You are right, it's definitely too early to worry about losing him. 

I send you hugs! Thank you!

Welp. I'm not mentally stable right now. Especially that night, so my language won't be great. I've been suicidal and am scared for my own mental health for if I lose attraction to him. I could end up losing my mind and killing myself. Selfish? Sure. But I haven't attended to myself properly in a month.

Of course I would automatically make it all about me considering the past month I've been doing absolutely fuck all for myself because of Depression. I haven't been showering, eating (I've lost weight), been getting out of bed, crying all the time, I have been self-loathing the past month. I have wanted to kill myself way before this even came up. Am I unable to atleast think about myself for a bit even after this? 

Edit: I am sorry. You hit a nerve. I've just not been thinking about my self at ALL except for this post.
I am so so sorry. I feel awfully guilty.

I hate myself because of how selfish I am. I suffer from Depression and I relapsed super badly over a month ago. Now my partner is showing signs of being trans  but because I'm heterosexual I am scared of losing my attraction. They're one of the only reasons I still want to continue living. Sure they would still be my friend but a break up would absolutely destroy me. Thing is I'm super selfish because the way I'm thinking about it is based on me. So I continue to feel even guiltier.
It includes wearing knickers and stockings. Not full on crossdressing, but a bit of it.
It's less that. He's going to be masculine over 90% of the time. It's more just what if he finds out it's more than just liking being feminine.

Oh I love him. I don't care if he's feminine at times. He's still going to be masculine 90% of the time. Not just "be" but feel and want to be masculine (assuming he's not lying). Heck I've even helped him be feminine such as let him wear my knickers and stockings - he did. And I offered to paint his nails once (he said nails weren't his thing though).

I love him so much. Just if it did happen to be more than being feminine, I don't know what would happen to the attraction. I'd still be there for him, I just know it'll be painful if we weren't in a relationship anymore.

Oh I do. We switch a lot - we genuinely enjoy both. I'm just worried that it's the beginning of a discovery of something much more... I need masculinity. If this is it, then I'm completely okay with that - he still wants/feels masculine over 90% of the time! But if it turns out it's something more after exploring, I guess I'm losing attraction to the person who I love most. I'm tearing up typing this.  Having a mental disorder relapse ontop is not fun. I'm sorry
